Static: text, labels, cards and scales for the opening. Fetch once; rules_digest names the rules. ETag names
the build and the rules: If-None-Match with it is a 304.

AccountPresentation.title: AccountPresentation
AccountPresentation.description:
What the page keeps about the player across saves. What gates a lesson or a lesson's hint is the save's
(SavePresentation), so a new game teaches everything again.

AccountSettings.title: AccountSettings
AccountSettings.description: The player's own choices for every game of the account. A write replaces them whole.

AimInfo.title: AimInfo
AimInfo.description: What a stretch of play is for: one line at the band's top, in content order (CONTRACT.txt, "The client may").

AnswerCause.title: AnswerCause
AnswerCause.description: The player's answer to an offer.

AnswerKind.title: AnswerKind
AnswerKind.description:
Order verb only (never a Decision): answer the first open offer of `offer_kind` with its answer of `role`
(CONTRACT.txt, "Offers"). 422 when no offer declares that kind and role.

AnswerOffer.title: AnswerOffer
AnswerOffer.description:
Answer a shown, open offer (CONTRACT.txt, "Offers"): 422 when the answer is not one of the offer's, or the
offer is not shown or already answered.

Blocker.title: Blocker
Blocker.description: The first unmet precondition, as the condition that would make it ready; ready_at null: not by itself.

CampCause.title: CampCause
CampCause.description: A Camp level reached: `level` as the Camp bar counts it, from 1.

CampInfo.title: CampInfo
CampInfo.description:
The bar to work toward: drawn from the ledger line of `store` (never drawn as a ledger line); its level is how
many of `camp_levels`' `at` the sample has reached (CONTRACT.txt).

Card.title: Card
Card.description:
An unlocked card that is not completed: one entry of the card panel, the same whether tapped, mixed or idle.
Tappable iff blocker is null and its lane's LaneBar has no running_card or cuts_in is true.

CardCount.title: CardCount
CardCount.description: Completions of a card, taps and mix together.

CardPresentation.title: CardPresentation
CardPresentation.description: How the page dresses a card; one mechanic under all three (CONTRACT.txt, "Cards").

Chapter.title: Chapter
Chapter.description: The figures of the newest return: what the chronicle's "Since you left" chapter shows beside its lines.

CompletedCard.title: CompletedCard
CompletedCard.description: An unlocked card at its cap: the Completed tab. It returns to View.cards if a cap is raised.

DeleteMix.title: DeleteMix
DeleteMix.description: Delete a saved mix (422 while another mix nests it or an order or queue entry names it).

EntryInfo.title: EntryInfo
EntryInfo.description: A page: a thing known, in content order. Written when view.unlocked holds `entry`.

Fight.title: Fight
Fight.description: One unlocked fight card or standing action, now (CONTRACT.txt, "FIGHTS").

FightInfo.title: FightInfo
FightInfo.description:
The odds a fight card or standing action runs under (CONTRACT.txt, "FIGHTS"): the strengths' ids, and what one lost
fight costs. The strengths themselves are View.fights.

Figure.title: Figure
Figure.description: A store's quantity or a level as the player left it (`was`) and as the return found it (`now`).

FindInfo.title: FindInfo
FindInfo.description: The amount a find puts in a store, for the text of its line: `line_key`'s `{found}` is quantity in whole items.

FirstMix.title: FirstMix
FirstMix.description:
The first mix the page offers once `feature` is unlocked and no mix exists: `card_ids` at an even split, saved
by the player's tap (CONTRACT.txt).

Forecast.title: Forecast
Forecast.description:
Everything that lands by `horizon_at` if the player changes nothing: orders, the queue and everything running
played out (engine DESIGN.txt, "Forecast"). It holds for every later view of the save until its next decision.
A time past horizon_at is unknown: draw none, never a guess.

ForecastAnswer.title: ForecastAnswer
ForecastAnswer.description: POST /api/saves/{save_id}/forecast: the save advanced to now, and its forecast from there.

Games.title: Games
Games.description: The account's saves (CONTRACT.txt, "Games on one account").

Goal.title: Goal
Goal.description:
One thing an open story beat waits on: a store's amount reaching `target` (store, value), a card's completions
reaching `target` or the card running at target 0 (card), a skill's level reaching `target` (skill), or a wait on
the clock alone landing at `at`. The page marks the store's line, the card or the skill's row; a store with no line
yet, and the clock, it states as a line of their own, the clock's naming what keeps it moving.

GoalLimit.title: GoalLimit
GoalLimit.description: A store a card moving the goal waits on, dry: the line that holds the goal back while it stays dry.

GoalRow.title: GoalRow
GoalRow.description:
How the setup as set moves one goal (CONTRACT.txt, "Goal rows"): a store reaching `target` (store) or a skill
reaching level `target` (skill), when it lands at today's rates, and the line that binds it.

Hand.title: Hand
Hand.description: How a note is written; each is a style the page owns, so a new one is page work as well as content.

JournalInfo.title: JournalInfo
JournalInfo.description: The book the player carries. Null in Content until a chapter declares it.

LaneBar.title: LaneBar
LaneBar.description: Which card a lane is tapping, and when the tap ends. The bar is the card's own (Card.bar).

LaneInfo.title: LaneInfo
LaneInfo.description:
Every lane, "hands" included. Its label is the label_key of the last of later_labels whose `after`
view.unlocked holds, else label_key (CONTRACT.txt, "A lane run by rules").

LessonEnd.title: LessonEnd
LessonEnd.description: How a lesson ended: for a round of testers, a skip clustered on one step marks it to cut.

LevelPays.title: LevelPays
LevelPays.description: What a level brings, shown before it lands: words (pays_key), "?" for a story unlock.

Limits.title: Limits
Limits.description: What the page's editors stop at (CONTRACT.txt, "Request limits"): a request past one is a 422.

MenuNode.title: MenuNode
MenuNode.description:
One node the skill's next pick may go into: `ranks_taken` of its `ranks` (drawn "2/5"), and its target's value
now and with one more rank, each at a full share: a make in rate units per hour, a card's work in work units per
second, a store's cap in quantity units (Scales).

MergeSummary.title: MergeSummary
MergeSummary.description: What joining would bring together (CONTRACT.txt, "Moving to another device").

MovePick.title: MovePick
MovePick.description:
By hand only: move the rank `node` holds on `skill`'s track to `to`, a node on SkillPrestige.menu_nodes. The rank
is out of play, held by neither node, until the click that lifts the skill into the phase after next. A refusal
is 422 invalid_decision.

Need.title: Need
Need.description:
A store a tap of the card needs. quantity: the most its input or any requirement on that store's value asks;
segment: how much there is, sampled like a ledger line's (served for a locked store too).
Drawn short while the sample is below quantity; whether the card is ready is still its blocker's to say. gate: drawn
in its place while set, the store unnamed (CONTRACT.txt, "Cards"); makers: the cards and standing actions in play
that make the store; spent: drawn as used up, set while short, nothing in play can make the store again and every
trigger that grants it has fired.

NodeChange.title: NodeChange
NodeChange.description:
What a node's ranks change, as the content authors it: `make`, what runner `id` (a card or standing action)
makes of `store`; `work`, card `id`'s work speed; `cap`, store `id`'s cap. The page names it by those ids' labels.

NodeInfo.title: NodeInfo
NodeInfo.description: One node of `skill`'s prestige track (CONTRACT.txt, "PRESTIGE PHASES"); SkillPrestige.menu_nodes names it.

NoteInfo.title: NoteInfo
NoteInfo.description: A note on a page, in content order. Its words are the text entry of the same id.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: A shown offer, in content order: `answer` null while it is open, else the answer given.

OfferedSwitch.title: OfferedSwitch
OfferedSwitch.description: A repeated switch (models.RepeatedSwitch) whose rule offer the player has answered.

OrderCard.title: OrderCard
OrderCard.description:
The prefilled rule offered when a store's line is falling and uncovered: `when` is an at_most on `store`, which
the page words from ui text (CONTRACT.txt, "Text and numbers"); `then` taps a card.

OrderState.title: OrderState
OrderState.description: Where a rule stands now, so the page can say why one is off (CONTRACT.txt, "THE CLIENT MAY").

ParkedPick.title: ParkedPick
ParkedPick.description: A rank a move parked on `node`: it takes effect at the click that lifts the skill into phase `due`.

Prestige.title: Prestige
Prestige.description:
By hand only, never an order's or a queue entry's verb (CONTRACT.txt, "PRESTIGE PHASES"): one rank into `node`
on `skill`'s track. At the skill's top it is the click into the next phase; with SkillPrestige.pick_owed it fills
that pick. A refusal is 422 invalid_decision, its message naming why.

ReminderOn.title: ReminderOn
ReminderOn.description: This browser's push subscription (PushSubscription.toJSON()'s endpoint and keys) and its time zone.

ReminderWindow.title: ReminderWindow
ReminderWindow.description:
When a reminder may come: once the player has been away `after_hours`, at a local hour from `send_from_hour` up
to `send_until_hour` (past midnight when from is later than until; equal: any hour).

RepeatedSwitch.title: RepeatedSwitch
RepeatedSwitch.description:
The player's own mix switched to `mix_id` `count` times in the window while `chip` showed (CONTRACT.txt,
"Repeats").

RepeatedTap.title: RepeatedTap
RepeatedTap.description:
A hands card tapped `count` times in the window while the hands ran a mix without it (CONTRACT.txt,
"Repeats").

Repeats.title: Repeats
Repeats.description: What the player keeps doing by hand, counted from the save's decision log: only what reached its count.

RuleChange.title: RuleChange
RuleChange.description:
A rule that came on (or, never coming on, let go) while the player was away, and how many times it came on
(1 where the page could not count more).

RuleDry.title: RuleDry
RuleDry.description:
A store rule's mix that cannot reach the rule's release for want of a store (CONTRACT.txt, "Dry rules"): the rule
holds the hands and the store is dry (`holding`), or no card of the mix makes the store, so the mix may stop short.

RuleRun.title: RuleRun
RuleRun.description:
One rule's entry: how many times it came on since its entry began, its last start and its last let-go (null
until it has let go), each with the amount of the store its condition reads (null for a condition on no store).
`order` is the rule as the save has it now: equal to one of View.orders, unless `ended` is set: the game removed
the rule, at a season's turn or when its person left, at off_at. on_at is null only on an ended rule that never
came on. `ended` "stint" is a goal stint that popped at its goal (CONTRACT.txt, "Rule runs"): `order` is
{when: its until, then: its switch_mix}, on_at when its mix began to run (null if the goal held as it came to
control), off_at when its goal landed. `made`, on an ended stint only: what the save gained, from on_at to off_at,
in the stores its mix's cards make, the goal's store first, then the largest, at most two; [] otherwise.

RunBy.title: RunBy
RunBy.description: Who runs a card now: never both on the hands, since a tap yields the mix.

RunnerCause.title: RunnerCause
RunnerCause.description: A card's run wrote the line (its line, outcome or finish), or a fight on a card or standing action did.

SavePresentation.title: SavePresentation
SavePresentation.description: What the page keeps about one save: its teaching (the lessons and what gates them or their hints) and its returns.

Section.title: Section
Section.description: The part of the book a page is in, each behind its own bookmark; within one, pages run in writing order.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: value(t) = start_value + rate * (t - start), held at limit once reached. The client samples this.

SkillCause.title: SkillCause
SkillCause.description: A level of `skill`: a line several of its levels share (a phase's pool), so the key cannot say which level.

SkillNeed.title: SkillNeed
SkillNeed.description: A level a card requires of a skill: listed on the card as ui.card.needs_skill, short while below it.

SkillPrestige.title: SkillPrestige
SkillPrestige.description: Where the skill stands in its prestige phases, at view.at.

SpentShare.title: SpentShare
SpentShare.description: The part, share_bp, of spent card `card`'s share that the card holding this entry runs now.

StandingBar.title: StandingBar
StandingBar.description: An unlocked standing action, maker or consumer: full, or paused by a dry store.

StandingInfo.title: StandingInfo
StandingInfo.description: A standing action: runs by itself while unlocked, outside every mix and lane.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: A save as just written: what to draw, and the lines the game wrote since it was last written.

StepNeed.title: StepNeed
StepNeed.description: A step a card requires: another card's completions, listed as ui.card.needs_step, short while below `count`.

Strength.title: Strength
Strength.description:
A side's power or a threat's strength: `value` is what the engine uses; `sources` are every source behind it, the
base first, then the sum entries, then the factors, each in stack order (CONTRACT.txt, "FIGHTS").

StrengthEntry.title: StrengthEntry
StrengthEntry.description: One source behind a strength: the base (source null), a sum entry (+1500 is +15%) or a factor (15000 is x1.5).

TapCard.title: TapCard
TapCard.description: One completion of a card by hand: a tap, a craft, a story step. The same verb from an order or the queue.

UndoPick.title: UndoPick
UndoPick.description:
By hand only: take back `skill`'s last pick while SkillPrestige.undo_open, leaving it owed. A refusal is 422
invalid_decision.

Unlock.title: Unlock
Unlock.description: `category`, not `kind`: on the wire `kind` is only ever a union's discriminator string.

Visit.title: Visit
Visit.description: A return after time away: the game second the player last saw the save, and the one the return came to.

WhenCause.title: WhenCause
WhenCause.description: What a story beat, an offer's arrival or a chip waited on, as the condition the content wrote for it.
